sonnet.problem: Card 6 already asked whether Jesus turns the stones into bread, and the answer was False. Card 7 asks the same fact again by saying 'He doesn't make the bread' and then asking what He answers with. The question also repeats card 6's answer.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: The right answer 'angels' already appears in the quoted words on story card 11 ('He will command His angels concerning You'), so the baker can answer card 17 from an earlier card's wording without reasoning it out.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
